turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We do not currently ship internationally outside of the United States and select regions of Canada.

Here’s how it works by region:

Contiguous United States, Alaska, Hawaii: We ship within these areas, but there are no customs or duties involved.
Canada (limited regions only): We do ship select items seasonally. For Canadian orders, all duties and taxes are already included in the CAD prices shown at checkout, so you would not pay additional customs fees on delivery.
All other countries: We are not able to ship there right now.

If you tell me which country you are in, I can confirm whether your area is within our current Canadian service regions or not.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

For most orders, standard shipping transit time is typically about 1–5 business days once your order leaves our nursery.

A couple of helpful details:

In the United States, you’ll choose an estimated delivery date at checkout. That date already factors in our prep time plus the normal carrier transit time to your address.
In eligible regions of Canada, you’ll choose a ship week at checkout, and orders usually arrive the following week after they’re sent to the border.

All dates are estimates, since weather and carrier delays can sometimes affect timing, but that 1–5 business day window is what we usually see for transit once the box is on the way.
